issues.detail: Hebrew 'תמריק' (from מרק, 'to cleanse/purge') is rendered as '驅散' (disperse/drive away), which changes the meaning from cleansing/purging to scattering. Also 'בְּרָע' means 'evil' (with preposition 'in/with'), but the Chinese '邪惡' is acceptable as object; however the verb meaning shift is substantive.
